name: GeoMath
description: GeoMath is a multimodal mathematical reasoning benchmark in the remote sensing domain, containing 3773 vehicle-related questions from aerial images across 6 mathematical subjects and 20 topics. It evaluates vision-language models' ability to perform high-resolution visual perception and domain-specific mathematical reasoning.
reputation: A specialized multimodal math benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly of interest to remote-sensing and vision-language researchers.
notes: Data collected by drones; challenges state-of-the-art VLMs; analyzes impact of image resolution and prompting strategies.
